x.description: The train split of the input data

y.description: The train split of the target output data

xValidate.description: The validation split of the input data

yValidate.description: The validation split of the target output data

xShape.description: Shape of {@link #x}. The keys match the key of `x` if `x` is a collection. Otherwise, key is "x".

yShape.description: Shape of {@link #y}. The keys match the key of `y` if `y` is a collection. Otherwise, key is "y".

xValidateShape.description: Shape of {@link #xValidate}. The keys match the key of `xValidate` if `xValidate` is a collection. Otherwise, key is "x".

yValidateShape.description: Shape of {@link #yValidate}. The keys match the key of `yValidate` if `yValidate` is a collection. Otherwise, key is "y".

title:
A type representing a single train / validation split of input and target output data. Refer to {@link MlSplit.Technique}
to see all possible validation techniques.
name: MlSplit
